notes: An engine run 10 minutes in icing with its own anti-ice off now gets a fan ice inspection that can be deferred (MEL category B, three days).
After 15 minutes in icing without that engine's anti-ice, the inspection must be done before the aircraft flies again. Before, 3 minutes grounded it.
Under 10 minutes there is no inspection item; the engine core still wears and the event is in the flight record.
